title: correction_or_withdrawal
description: A correction or withdrawal record for any water-planning entity. Prior state is preserved via digest linkage. A correction does not constitute a new award, decision, or project record.

subject_ref.description: Reference to the entity being corrected or withdrawn.

action_type.description: Whether this record represents a correction or a full withdrawal.

prior_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the prior record state, ensuring historical lineage is preserved.

correction_time.description: Time the source published this correction.
